question: The radius of a sphere is 14 cm. What is the surface area of this sphere? [Use π = (22)/(7)]
solution:
**Given:**

The radius of a sphere is 14 cm

**Formula used:**

The surface area of the sphere = 4 π r² 

**Calculations:**

SA = 4 × π × (14)² 

⇒ SA = 4 × 22/7 × (196) 

⇒ SA = 4 × 22 × 28 = 2464 cm² 

**∴ The surface area of this sphere is 2464 cm2.**
